honest_boundary: No manifold, no Ricci-flow PDE, no conjugate heat kernel is constructed.
BallVolumeComparison is an explicit analytic hypothesis, not proved.
The reduced-volume certificate fields (derivative sign, positivity) are D7 certificate data, not discharged.
The entropy monotonicity consumed is the D7 PerelmanWMuKernelHypotheses interface; only the algebraic transfer is kernel-checked.
kappa is uniform only conditional on the reference-time lower bound v0 <= Vtilde(tau0).
fullPerelmanNoncollapsing is a state-only Prop, not a theorem.
No surgery, canonical-neighbourhood, sphere-recognition or Poincare content is claimed.
